data_quality_notes: Single-family detached only. Excludes Dana Point condos/townhomes.

June 2026 median sales price ($2.10M) and median price-per-sqft ($972) both dropped sharply from May ($3.15M / $1,538) and April ($2.99M / $1,442). Both metrics moving together indicates a lower-priced MIX of homes closed in June, not a single outlier. Recent SFR medians bounce widely at low monthly transaction counts.

Active Listings and Pending Sales reports were not exported this pull; months-of-supply (3.2) and DOM (13) still show a tight market. Inventory months supply has held flat at 3.2 for Apr-May-Jun 2026, down from 4.3 a year ago.
This pull swapped the usual Active Listings + Pending Sales reports for a Median Price Per Square Foot report.
